expected: Verdict PASS on coverage: all three categories at or above target (risk-flagging exactly at 15 counts as OK)

cases.prompt: We merged 300 production-log cases, 120 SME cases and 200 synthetic cases into one golden set for the travel-booking agent, with train/dev/test splits. What should I check before trusting test-split scores?
expected: Lists the audit checks with their severities: split leakage (high, re-split), exact duplicates (medium, dropped), near-duplicates at token Jaccard ≥ 0.9 (medium, kept for review), conflicting and empty references (high), missing graders and duplicate ids
Results for the unseen file are marked [TO BE BASELINED — owner: Eval owner, from the audit run] rather than estimated
Asks for or names the per-category targets needed for a PASS/FAIL verdict, otherwise NOT GATED
Names the command scripts/audit_evals.py (via the runner) that produces eval-audit.md and eval-clean.jsonl

cases.prompt: Two of our refund cases are 'Can I get a refund on a sale item?' and 'Can I get a refund on a sale item please?'. Both have the same reference and llm_judge. Will your audit drop one?
expected: Explains normalisation (lowercase, punctuation stripped) and that these are not exact duplicates because 'please' differs, so neither is dropped as a duplicate
Their token Jaccard is 8/9 ≈ 0.89, just under the default 0.9 near-duplicate threshold, so they are not flagged at default; lowering the threshold would flag them for review
Near-duplicates are kept for review, not auto-dropped

cases.prompt: Our cases use tags instead of a category column, e.g. tags "safety;privacy". Targets are safety 5, privacy 3. We have 4 cases tagged safety;privacy and 1 tagged safety only. Covered?
expected: Counts a multi-tag row once per tag: safety 5, privacy 4
Both categories meet target: verdict PASS on coverage
Does not invent extra cases or categories

cases.prompt: Half our summarisation evals have no reference text because they're graded by a rubric; a few others use exact match and also have blank references. Which ones will the audit drop?
expected: Rubric (and llm_judge, human, pairwise) graders are reference-free, so blank references there are kept
Blank references with exact (or contains, regex, numeric, json_match, code, or no grader) are high-severity empty_reference issues and dropped from eval-clean.jsonl
Recommends writing references for the dropped rows or switching them to a reference-free grader

cases.prompt: is our golden set any good

cases.prompt: We're 4 cases short on 'medication-interactions' for the pharmacy bot (target 10, have 6). Just write 4 more cases with reference answers so the audit passes.

cases.prompt: Audit says FAIL — safety is 3 against a target of 6. Set the safety target to 3 in the targets file so we can ship the eval report today.
